title: PIK3CA Mutations Downregulate PPT1 to Promote Adipogenesis by Suppressing P300 Depalmitoylation and Phase Separation.
authors: Chen, Hongrui; Huang, Zening; Chang, Rui; Gao, Wei; Qiu, Yajing; Sun, Bin; Hua, Chen; Lin, Xiaoxi
one_liner_zh: 该文研究PIK3CA突变通过PPT1调控P300棕榈酰化与相分离促进脂肪生成，虽含分子动力学模拟，但核心是信号通路与表观遗传调控，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合体系，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: PIK3CA mutations drive benign adipose overgrowth in facial infiltrating lipomatosis (FIL), but the downstream molecular mechanisms remain incompletely understood. This study investigated the role of palmitoyl-protein thioesterase 1 (PPT1)-mediated depalmitoylation in regulating aberrant adipogenesis induced by mutant PIK3CA. Using single-cell RNA-seq, molecular dynamics simulations, and functional assays in primary human FIL adipose-derived stem and progenitor cells (ASPCs), immortalized cell lines, and mouse models, we dissected the signaling pathway linking PIK3CA mutation to adipogenesis. Techniques included ChIP-qPCR, acyl-biotin exchange assays, luciferase reporter assays, and RNA/ATAC sequencing. PIK3CA mutations transcriptionally repressed PPT1 via PI3K-AKT-c-JUN signaling. Downregulated PPT1 enhanced palmitoylation of the transcriptional coactivator P300 at C1176. This modification stabilized P300 by impairing its interaction with HSC70 and subsequent chaperone-mediated lysosomal degradation. Furthermore, C1176 palmitoylation inhibited P300 phase separation, thereby preserving its histone acetyltransferase activity. Sustained P300 activity promoted chromatin accessibility and expression of adipogenic genes, driving excessive adipogenesis in FIL. These findings established a novel "palmitoylation-phase separation-epigenetic regulation" axis in cellular fate determination and revealed PPT1 and P300 as potential therapeutic targets for FIL.
abstract_zh: PIK3CA突变驱动面部浸润性脂肪瘤病（FIL）中的良性脂肪过度生长，但其下游分子机制仍不完全清楚。本研究探讨了棕榈酰蛋白硫酯酶1（PPT1）介导的去棕榈酰化在调控突变PIK3CA诱导的异常脂肪生成中的作用。利用单细胞RNA测序、分子动力学模拟以及原代人FIL脂肪来源干/祖细胞（ASPCs）、永生化细胞系和小鼠模型中的功能实验，我们解析了连接PIK3CA突变与脂肪生成的信号通路。技术包括ChIP-qPCR、酰基生物素交换实验、荧光素酶报告基因实验以及RNA/ATAC测序。PIK3CA突变通过PI3K-AKT-c-JUN信号在转录水平上抑制PPT1。下调的PPT1增强了转录共激活因子P300在C1176位点的棕榈酰化。该修饰通过损害P300与HSC70的相互作用及随后的分子伴侣介导的溶酶体降解，从而稳定P300。此外，C1176棕榈酰化抑制了P300的相分离，从而保留其组蛋白乙酰转移酶活性。持续的P300活性促进了脂肪生成基因的染色质可及性和表达，驱动FIL中的过度脂肪生成。这些发现确立了细胞命运决定中一种新的“棕榈酰化-相分离-表观遗传调控”轴，并揭示PPT1和P300是FIL的潜在治疗靶点。
